prompt_for_image_ai: Flat vector full-body illustration, 640x640, fully transparent PNG outside the frame. Draw a wonky skewed rounded quadrilateral border — NOT a straight rectangle: left edge leans slightly inward, top edge slopes down left-to-right, right edge nearly vertical with soft outward bow, bottom edge slopes up left-to-right, all corners heavily rounded like a bubble sticker. Border stroke solid deep purple #4B2C7F, medium weight about 5px, transparent interior except character. Lineless Corporate Memphis style — no black outlines, flat fills, minimal cel-shade on clothes. Young woman, SHS-college age, light peach skin, dark hair in low ponytail, minimal dot eyes looking at notes. White blouse under purple #4B2C7F cardigan with teal #4DB6AC buttons, dark trousers, dark loafers. Three-quarter pose, open notebook in one hand, magnifying glass with teal lens glint in other, three small teal floating dots near glass. Figure off-center toward right inside frame. Curious analytical pathfinder energy. NO text, NO letters, NO background fill, NO white canvas — transparent alpha outside purple border.
